_comment: Remote selector config for the LinkedIn AI Detector. This is the file that lets you fix LinkedIn DOM changes WITHOUT shipping a new extension package: edit it, commit to the default branch, and installed extensions pick it up within a few hours (background.js fetches it on launch + on a 6h alarm). It is DATA, not code (Chrome Web Store compliant). The extension always ships with these same values bundled as a fallback, so if this file is missing/unreachable/invalid, detection still works on the built-in defaults. Keys mirror LAID_DEFAULT_CONFIG in content.js. Bump 'version' whenever you change selectors so clients know to apply the update.

selectors.postMarker: button[aria-label^="Open control menu for post by"]
